UPDATE
	match_iteration 
SET status ='FAILED'
WHERE ep_stage_id='#{epStageId}' 
AND status NOT IN ('ALGO_TRIGGER_FAIL', 'ALGO_FAILED','COMPLETED','FAILED')
AND (EXTRACT(day from AGE(current_timestamp, executed_at))>1 
OR (EXTRACT(day from AGE(current_timestamp, executed_at))=0 
AND EXTRACT(hour from AGE(current_timestamp, executed_at)) > #{maxHourTimeAllowed}));
